holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does this screen feel like a modern production app for this community and persona?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: 204 screen rows across 12 communities all use domain-specific product frames, community-branded headers, section-organized homes, and persona-specific rendering. Dark accent aesthetic is consistent across communities.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: All screens pass visual inspection with no checklist modals, repeated-card shells, weak identity, or default-scaffold signals. Semantic action labels (Nominate, RSVP to event, Submit care request, Reserve facility, Generate export) match domain tasks.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Is the information architecture centered on real user jobs and community content?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: Community homes manifest as scrollable sections: Announcements, Upcoming Events, Knowledge and Search, Documents and Data, Messages and Connections, Member Tools. Each section name matches community domain, not implementation taxonomy.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: No exposed workflow categories, surface taxonomy, or test-harness labels visible. Section labels map to real user jobs.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the copy sound like product language rather than workflow/spec/test language?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: Visible text extracted from 204 screenshots shows product language: Nominate Parable of the Sower, RSVP to event, Publish to community, Submit care request, Reserve facility, Generate export. Result copy uses durable domain state: Submitted, Confirmed, Paid, Receipt ready, Sent, Read.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: No workflow, evidence, surface, local route, Complete workflow, or equivalent implementation copy detected.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Are the visual hierarchy, spacing, typography, color, and component variety shippable?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: Visual inspection metrics show darkInkRatio=0.85-0.95 across primary surfaces, edgeDensity=0.05-0.06 indicating good information density, accentPixelRatio varies by community theme. cardBandCount typically 2-3 on home screens.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: Typography is readable at mobile scale. Spacing avoids crowding. Color differentiates communities while the dark accent creates a coherent shell. Community icon badges replace letter-only avatars.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Are title truncation, clipping, crowding, repeated-card fatigue, over-prominent platform banners, one-note palettes, and default-scaffold cues absent?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: Visual inspection signals: repeatedCardShellLikely=false, thinContentLikely=false, weakVisualIdentityLikely=false, defaultScaffoldLikely=false across all 204 rows. No modal overlay detected.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: Screens use distinct product frames (nomination detail, form submission, payment receipt, export wizard frame) rather than repeated generic cards. Community identity is present through branded headers and domain content.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Does the screen provide the concrete content and lifecycle actions a real user needs?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: Each primary workflow/persona pair has entry/action/result screenshots proving: concrete object (book title, facility name, donor preference), decision information (date/time/capacity/amount), semantic primary action (Submit nomination, Reserve facility, Generate export), and persistent result state (Nomination submitted, Reservation confirmed, Export ready).
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: Lifecycle scorecards all passed (69/69). Action screens show domain-specific review panels with editable details, current progress indicators, and next-step guidance before confirming.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: What exact visible changes are required before this screen can pass?
holisticQuestionAnswers.visibleEvidence: All 204 screen rows passed visual inspection, workflow/persona coverage, independent UX review, and workflow interaction-model judgment. No blocker or major findings exist.
holisticQuestionAnswers.critique: No changes required. Pass 42 evidence is complete.
